B2: ETB2− — H-bridge 2 negative, 6 A maximum (per original connector drawing)
B3: ETB12V — H-bridge 12 V supply; fuse up to 10 A per drawing
B4: ETB1+ — H-bridge 1 positive, 6 A maximum (per original connector drawing)
B5: ETB1− — H-bridge 1 negative, 6 A maximum (per original connector drawing)
B8: KEY/VIN — ECU and HS1–HS4 supply
B13: WB12V+ — Wideband 12 V power; fuse up to 10 A per drawing
B20: HS2 — VBAT high-side, 2 A max
B21: HS1 — VBAT high-side, 2 A max
B22: HS4 — VBAT high-side, 2 A max
B23: HS3 — VBAT high-side, 2 A max
